parent.title: Extending Claude Code: MCP, Skills, Plugins — a session-3 blueprint

siblings.title: MCP deep-dive
siblings.summary: Talk-prep brief for a 1–2 hour deep-dive on the Model Context Protocol — architecture, 2026 spec, ecosystem, security trifecta, and live-demo recipes.

siblings.title: Claude Code Skills
siblings.summary: A Skill is a Markdown file + optional bundled scripts that Claude loads on demand. Cheaper than CLAUDE.md, more discoverable than a slash command, lighter than a subagent — and now an open cross-vendor standard.

siblings.title: Plugins & the Marketplace
siblings.summary: What plugins actually are, how the official + community marketplaces work, the few that earn their keep, and the trust footgun to flag in any 1–2 hour deep-dive.

siblings.title: Subagents, hooks, and the rest of the harness
siblings.summary: One-page mental model for teaching Claude Code's harness: subagents (isolation), hooks (determinism), and the config substrate (skills, permissions, settings).

siblings.title: Comparison & decision framework
siblings.summary: Score candidate topics on four axes — audience fit, series continuity, speaker readiness, demo viability — with weights chosen before scoring. Skip RICE; it's product-feature shaped.

sources.title: Exemplar Global — VILT best practices
sources.claim: Peer collab beats lecture for retention; design interaction every 10-15 min.

sources.title: Airmeet — high-engagement virtual training
sources.claim: Average viewer checks email after ~10 min of passive content; co-host on chat keeps speaker in flow.

sources.title: WebinarJam — best webinar length 2026
sources.claim: Keep monologue stretches under ~7 min; alternate with interaction.

sources.title: vFairs — run of show
sources.claim: Demos beat slides; distribute run-of-show; pre-record demo as fallback.

sources.title: Lou Bergholz — running virtual training >90 min
sources.claim: Past 90 minutes without a break is a separate session, not a stretch goal.

sources.title: Contrast — webinar benchmarks 2026
sources.claim: Series replays compound; Q&A lifts retention ~32%; continuity offers convert 25-40%; multi-session series ~2.3× the leads.

sources.title: UPCEA — deep-dive workshop design
sources.claim: Deep-dives are designed to leave participants with a take-away product, not just slides.

sources.title: Baylor — DIVE designed-instruction guide
sources.claim: Every 10-15 min should have a planned interaction.
